Read the complete admission Owner and every product call site. Fixed shapes are private detached snapshots with typed properties and Owner serialization. Selection, ownership, history digest, complete recipient Run/Assistant witnesses, clone provenance and missing/null rejection have a single validator; no dictionary compatibility interface remains. Dynamic storage/Engine consumers use the existing transaction and validated bindings; the public stored schema and error text are unchanged. JSON syntax ownership review: validator calls now target JsonObject. The validator body is AST-identical after expanding its canonical declarations; each consumer AST is identical after normalizing only that call/import, and every original import scope is preserved, including the isolated worker. Record-specific mandatory fields, policy, identity, version, CAS, effects and permission validation are unchanged. ProjectConfig retains a direct public delegate, never a second validator.

reason: Read complete manifest/record projections and validation, paired name/revision witnesses, permanent deletion evidence, operation event Writer and common step observation. Fixed fields come from dataclass slots or Owner Field declarations; record keys and revisions are dynamic validated identities. Only absent fresh checkpoint/initialization can supply empty records. Exact current schema/owner/revision and saved interactions remain mandatory. Retirement uses Run active-state declaration and its declared terminal exceptions; abandonment evidence stays required for failed/interrupted/paused Runs. Common step reads do not interpret private payloads or grant resume permission. Nested scope projection review: existing CheckpointEnvelope lifecycle validation and new construction reuse the same retry-required predicate; Reader rejects contradictory explicit evidence as before. CheckpointContent emits a validated runtime content projection in the existing header/records order. CheckpointStep owns required interaction attachment and separate nullable waiting observation, retaining original values without normalizing opaque input. No storage schema, lifecycle, authority or ACK boundary changes. Agent usage Reader obtains mandatory lifecycle status through CheckpointStep.required_status, retaining the original KeyError and no missing-record fallback; no other record/interaction behavior changed. Agent execution closure: required-Tool completion shares one AgentPolicy validator. Pause reference owns only its event field, preserving storage existence validation and Engine-specific private pause keys. Selected resources retain pair unpacking with named access. Optional Engine hooks and graph parent-name fallback retain the existing protocol and missing/null distinction; no stored evidence is manufactured. Connected original Run consumers to canonical admitted snapshot Writers, scalar checkpoint projection, explicit operation/plan values and public optional Engine/Capability hooks. No default, migration, runtime authority or persistence format change; existing incomplete Hub contracts remain tracked.

reason: Read complete output/delta/reference and Completion receipt/container/result implementation. Dataclass fields define wire; Owner validation reads slot-derived names, required fields remain mandatory, and enum/constraint/default/diagnostic declarations precede implementation. Completion container uses typed identities and Owner validation, preserving finalization, live stored list updates, immutable reservation ID/Step/start/tokens, retained unknown usage and terminal end evidence. Output copies open JSON, preserves identity/sequence/final behavior; query result delegates stored observation fields and TokenUsage aggregation. No additional persisted result or authority is created. Agent output review: the existing None data default moves to OutputContract.NO_DATA and has_data exposes its original identity check. AgentOutputValue preserves the distinct absent field versus explicitly parsed JSON null; all EngineOutput fields, JSON validation, copy, identity and finalization remain unchanged. CompletionResult now also owns partial/final normalized observations using its declared slot names. Original field read/merge/reasoning order, deep copies, received-but-undrained unknown usage and drained-before-finish evidence are preserved across 45 old/new decoder traces. Stored fields and record validation remain identical.

Project/Session JSON copies/target validation, components initialization, Agent binding and active Run identity/evidence remain. Step observations delegate the existing typed envelope Owner; clocks/UUIDs are generated only by creation, never missing-record repair. Context-specific mode categories now have one predicate declaration; Message unbound Run and detached-copy mutation are explicit. All prior methods and current stored fields/defaults remain unchanged; prior shared contract decisions are retained. Message.validate_changes delegates complete proposed-record validation to its existing Reader without new fields, defaults or mutable state. Existing consumers and their prior decisions are preserved. History consumers share existing Session retention marker and Message pending states without coercion, default or category change; prior Owner contracts and classifications remain intact. Connected original Run consumers to canonical admitted snapshot Writers, scalar checkpoint projection, explicit operation/plan values and public optional Engine/Capability hooks. No default, migration, runtime authority or persistence format change; existing incomplete Hub contracts remain tracked. Narrow lifecycle consumers now use existing domain state/error/path declarations, optional Component hooks and explicit model-observation contract. Pure guards/projections preserve required lookup and live-client semantics; no stored format or execution permission change. Narrow public Facade consumers use the Run-owned resumable candidate states, EngineEvent factory, live RunManager gauges and uncommitted operation preview. All required safety checks and original read/effect order remain.

reason: Read all model invocation values, finite JSON/object/nested usage validators, exact current-record Reader, normalized enums, per-format serializers and runtime copy. Fields derive from owning slots instead of implementation strings; ModelRecord declares shared version field/versioned selection but each format keeps its separate VERSION. Writer retains exact field order, explicit null/false/zero, typed nested content/calls/results and opaque signed state. Strict role/result pairing, no interleaving/duplicate exchanges, nonnegative exact counts, ranking/embedding validation and no multimodal text destruction remain. Runtime parameters preserve injected client/callback identity while mutable containers detach, and serialization rejects runtime handles. These values cannot authorize tools/retries or release reservations; actual Adapter/Loop/RAG/processing/Hub consumers are tested.

Corrected RunPolicy declaration location; explicit-only selection, whole-turn preservation, separate usage quota and runtime handle identity agree with the verified code. This README defines no executable literals, dynamic lookup, schema or second policy source.

Read complete definition Schema/validation/revision/mode selection and Record/Catalog/Binding Writer/Reader/update guard. Canonical names are declared and Schema exports unchanged plain strings, preserving exact diagnostics and ordering. Resource categories remain local Agent inputs, schema references local-only, no default definition/authorization added. Records require every current field with exact integer version and recomputed identity/revision; catalog is immutable and requires a manifest. Admission binding remains separate from execution and current definition, optional request context remains explicit, and Run evidence cannot change. Whole-file candidate/dynamic review is complete, but raw definition consumers in Engine/lifecycle/Hub still need migration and that contract remains explicitly incomplete. Agent resource/profile review: added canonical capability identity or validated detached AgentProfile/Policy/ResourceSelection projection, retaining exact original Schema/Reader/revision and stored omission/null/explicit values. Prompt/Skill capability declarations now originate in their pure record Owner and Component names refer to it. ToolPolicyValues declares the same None unrestricted set and shares only the existing subset predicate with preflight and child scope creation. Old/new definition wire/revision, selection/binding/capabilities, input/output Schema and scope limits match; all earlier file contracts and incomplete consumer tracking remain. Engine factory/schema review: selected validation delegates unchanged AgentDefinition rules with the same diagnostic identifier; canonical SchemaExtension and EngineConfigurationKey share key selection/writing across Graph/Loop/Registry/settings. Original key scalar acceptance is preserved separately from typed response validation. ConfigurationView.resolver owns optional public resolution discovery; absence/default/explicit inputs are unchanged. Existing complete and incomplete contracts remain tracked. Agent execution closure: required-Tool completion shares one AgentPolicy validator. Pause reference owns only its event field, preserving storage existence validation and Engine-specific private pause keys. Selected resources retain pair unpacking with named access. Optional Engine hooks and graph parent-name fallback retain the existing protocol and missing/null distinction; no stored evidence is manufactured. Refinement binding delta: AgentResourceSelection now owns the explicit detached resources.skills edit Writer. Prior Agent methods are unchanged; actual full lifecycle/callback/failure comparisons and original Skill/Agent/approval/CAS tests agree. Prior complete/incomplete contracts and their evidence links are preserved. Connected original Run consumers to canonical admitted snapshot Writers, scalar checkpoint projection, explicit operation/plan values and public optional Engine/Capability hooks. No default, migration, runtime authority or persistence format change; existing incomplete Hub contracts remain tracked.
